title: Website Animation Effect Registry
description: Machine-readable decomposition of website animation effects, structured so an AI can reproduce each one exactly in a website build prompt. One record per effect, every record answerable as build instructions.

families.description: Grouping key (A-I) used to cluster effects by engineering discipline.

slots.description: Named regions of the target page. Each effect is assigned to exactly one slot so no two effects fight for the same surface.

id.description: Stable identifier, zero-padded, in source order.

name.description: Effect name as a designer would recognise it.

family.description: Engineering family. A Spatial/Dimensional, B Narrative/Scroll, C Type/Brand, D Vector Craft, E Atmosphere, F Interaction/UI, G State/Feedback, H Surface Styles, I Editorial/Media.

one_liner.description: What the effect is, in one sentence an AI can reason about.

intent.description: Why it exists — the user-facing job it does. Drives whether an AI should keep it when adapting the design.

trigger.description: What starts the animation: load, in-view, scroll, hover, focus, click, pointer, idle-loop, state-change, navigation, data-loading, multi-user, session.

stack.description: Concrete technologies that implement the effect. Must be implementable client-side.

slot.description: Page region key from `slots`. Guarantees coverage: every slot is populated and every effect has a home.

placement.description: Exactly where and how the effect appears, in build terms.

params.description: Motion values. A number is a scalar; a two-item array is a [min,max] range; a string is a named mode or loop description.

gpu.description: Whether the effect composites on the GPU (transform/opacity/filter) rather than repainting layout.

frame_budget_ms.description: Milliseconds of the 16.7ms frame this effect may consume.

prefers_reduced_motion.description: The mandatory non-animated fallback. Never optional.

acceptance.description: Binary, testable checks. If any fails, the effect is not done.

prompt_line.description: A single imperative sentence that can be pasted directly into a build prompt. Composed of trigger + technique + placement + constraints.
